newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China EB Holdings seen seeking syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: China EB Holdings seen seeking syndicated loan.

text.p: China Everbright Holdings Co Ltd is seeking to raise money through a loan to help fund its purchase of 7.74 percent of Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd, bankers said on Monday.
A mainland banker said China Everbright was talking to bankers about funding the HK$11.4 billion purchase.
CITIC Pacific Ltd said on May 9 it had agreed to sell 904.69 million shares or 7.74 percent of Hongkong Telecom to China Everbright, which has to make payment by June 3.
China Everbright is the mainland parent of China Everbright International Ltd, China Everbright Technology Ltd and China Everbright-IHD Pacific Ltd.
